name: orca-coordinator
description: Your coordinator agent in Orca: an Orca plugin that sets up the coordinator, its rules, board, playbooks and automations, and shows the board.

scripts.types: orca plugin types . && rm -rf types/orca-plugin && cp -R .orca/types types/orca-plugin
scripts.check: node --test "test/**/*.test.mjs" && npm run typecheck && orca plugin validate . && orca plugin test .
